title: Permanent Staff Modifiers
text: Place the staff on the middle of the advanced assembly table's three nodes. Fill its left and right nodes and six regular slots with eight identical materials: iron blocks for enhancement, clocks for delay, light microcores for holy magic, or spiritual crystals for infusion.

Each installation uses one enhancement slot and preserves parts, enchantments and runes. Wooden and blaze shafts have one slot; shadow shafts have two. Repeated modifiers are allowed within capacity and cannot be removed. A driving spell core is required.
